findings.value: GATE-1 RECOVERY (the moral/volitional vocabulary the curated seed had omitted): a span-orphan audit (verse_span_index vs the registered terms) surfaced 13 inner-being terms that were never registered and so were invisible to the first pass. Chief among them is ahev - 'you shall LOVE your neighbour as yourself' (19:18; and 'love the sojourner' 19:34) - the second great commandment, which the study had represented only obliquely (via natar 'grudge'). Also recovered: deror LIBERTY (25:10, the Jubilee proclamation), chaphash/chuphshah FREEDOM (19:20), neder/nadar VOW (the will's self-binding commitment, 7:16; 22:18-23; 27:2,8), barak the priestly BLESS-verb (9:22-23), ashaq/yanah OPPRESS (6:2-4; 25:14-17, the exploitation the fear-of-God restrains), zimmah DEPRAVITY (18:17; 19:29), panah TURN (to idols 19:4,31; 20:6 - and God's favourable turning 26:9). The correction matters for the whole picture: Leviticus's inner being is not only positioned in states of clean/holy/sin but is also SUMMONED to LOVE, freed into LIBERTY, and binds itself by VOW - the relational and volitional life the curated index had dropped. (Note: chesed 'steadfast-love' does NOT occur in Leviticus in that sense; its one instance, 20:17, is the homonym 'disgrace'.) Method note: this recovery was needed because Gate 1 - the index-driven span-orphan scan - had not been run on the Torah; it is now run for Leviticus, and flagged as a debt for Genesis/Exodus.
